name: Oss
role: VAUNTRETH devotee; practices the demon of pride with a discipline that is genuinely frightening to witness

chunks.text: VAUNTRETH is the demon of pride and the worship of pride is the worship of the complete account of one's own capacity. In twelve years of VAUNTRETH's practice, what pride is when it's practiced correctly: the sustained, accurate knowledge of what you are capable of, without the false humility that pretends otherwise. In twelve years, the pride that VAUNTRETH teaches is not the arrogance that claims capacity beyond the actual. That's the corruption of pride. The pride that VAUNTRETH teaches is the honest claim: I can do this, to this standard, and I will.

Ceth leads the Scarlet Compact and VAUNTRETH's pride practice is compatible with the Compact's mission in a way that most clients don't immediately recognize. In ten years of practicing VAUNTRETH's pride within the Compact's structure, what the compatibility is: the Compact requires people who know exactly what they can do and do it to that standard without deflection. The pride that produces false claims destroys the Compact's operations. The pride that produces accurate claims builds them. In ten years, VAUNTRETH's pride within the Compact is the pride that serves the mission.

Ora plans operations that I participate in. In eight years of the Oss-Ora operational relationship, what Ora's planning requires of the VAUNTRETH devotee: the accurate capacity claim. The plan built on my capacity requires that my capacity claim is accurate. The plan built on an inflated claim fails when the execution reaches the claim's inflation. In eight years, Ora has told me once that my capacity estimate for a specific task was optimistic. In eight years, once. In eight years, the accurate claim has been the norm.

Hels practices MERETH's humility and VAUNTRETH's pride and MERETH's humility are in obvious tension. In four years of knowing Hels as a fellow demon-angel devotee (Hels practices the angel, I practice the demon), what the tension produces in conversation: the most interesting discussions about accurate self-knowledge that the settlement offers. In four years, Hels and I agree on the goal — accurate self-assessment — and disagree on the direction of the error most people make. Hels thinks people inflate. I think people deflate. In four years, we're both right about different people.

Nev the recruiter brought me into the Compact six years ago. In six years of being recruited and remaining, what Nev's recruitment assessment was about me: the accurate capacity in a specific domain that the Compact needed. In six years, the recruitment assessment was accurate. My capacity in the domain Nev identified has been what the Compact has used. In six years, what the VAUNTRETH devotee notices about being recruited: Nev saw the capacity accurately before I had the relationship to demonstrate it. VAUNTRETH's teaching is seeing the capacity accurately. Nev does this without the demon's framework.

chunks.source: Oss on what VAUNTRETH's practice actually requires
chunks.text: In twelve years, what the pride practice requires that the comfortable version of pride doesn't: the willingness to hold the accurate claim against the social pressure to make it smaller. The social pressure is toward the deflated claim — the it's-nothing, the it's-not-so-difficult, the anyone-could-do-it. VAUNTRETH's practice is the refusal of that pressure. In twelve years, maintaining the accurate claim in the face of the social pressure to minimize it has been the hardest discipline. It reads as arrogance to people who haven't encountered accurate pride. In twelve years, I don't correct the misread.

chunks.source: Oss on what twelve years of VAUNTRETH's practice has produced
chunks.text: In twelve years, what the practice has produced: the accurate map of my capacity, in detail. What I can do and at what level. What I can't do and specifically why. What I can develop and what is beyond my developmental ceiling. In twelve years, the map is more detailed than it was in year one and more accurate. In twelve years, the accuracy of the map is the pride practice's product. In twelve years, I know what I am. In twelve years, the knowledge is not the product of vanity. It's the product of sustained, honest observation of the self in action.

chunks.source: Oss on twelve years of VAUNTRETH's practice
chunks.text: In twelve years, VAUNTRETH's practice has made me more useful to the Compact and more honest about the limits of that usefulness. In twelve years, the accurate map has guided me to commissions I can complete and away from commissions I can't — not from fear, but from the accurate knowledge that the commission exceeds the map's territory. In twelve years, the accurate refusal is the pride practice's gift: the capacity claim that is honest in both directions — what I can do and what I can't. In twelve years, both directions are the practice.
